### Oh Lord, It’s Hard to Be Holy
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/oh-lord-it-s-hard-to-be-holy-crosswalk-the-devotional-feb-23-2012.html
Passage: Leviticus 11:44
Points:
- The endless struggle to keep a messy kitchen floor clean mirrors human difficulty in staying pure.
- Reading through the extensive purity commands in Leviticus reveals that total holiness is impossible through self-effort alone.
- The Old Testament requirements ultimately highlight a person's need for a Savior.
- Believers are declared clean and holy through Christ's sacrifice rather than personal perfection.
- Walking in holiness means resting in God's grace and relying on His strength every day.

### A Holy Life
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-august-24-2015.html
Passage: Leviticus 11:44-45
Points:
- God summons His people to a distinct life characterized by moral excellence and beauty.
- Cultivating genuine spiritual maturity and holiness takes patience and ongoing effort.
- The spiritual adversary actively seeks ways to demoralize and derail the believer's walk.
- Believers must invite God to purify their thoughts, speech, and habits to bring glory to Him.

### Read the Bible: Leviticus 11-12, Psalms 13-14, Prov. 26, and 1 Thess. 5
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-11-12-psalms-13-14-prov-26-1-thess-5/
Passage: Leviticus 11:44-45
Points:
- Holiness is primarily an attribute of God Himself and derivatively applies to whatever is reserved exclusively for Him.
- The call to be holy appears specifically in the context of dietary restrictions rather than only moral laws.
- Genuine holiness means belonging wholly to God and living on His terms.
- Denying God's reality and authority represents the ultimate opposite of true holiness.

### Bible Pathways 02/05/05
Author: Bible Pathways Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-05-or-05-1309504.html
Passage: Leviticus 11:44
Points:
- God repeatedly instructs His covenant people to consecrate themselves and remain holy as He is holy.
- The dietary regulations in Leviticus 11 reminded Israel that devotion to God touches ordinary daily activities.
- Distinguishing clean from unclean reinforced the gravity and defiling nature of sin.
- New Testament believers are likewise called to honor God by presenting their bodies as living and holy sacrifices.
